steps.content: If the mole orchestrated both explosions, then the blasts themselves were just a means to an end. The real clues—perhaps even the mole itself—were still on site.
You wrench your hand from Helene's grip and sprint after Nolaine through the doorway.

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: What the hell are you doing here?! Desk jockeys like you will just get in my way!

With a flash of movement, she pulverizes a falling slab with a powerful kick, clearing the path. In the same instant, she seizes your arm, yanks you back from danger, and shoves you forcefully into the safety of the adjacent area.

options: Are you trying to destroy evidence?

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: Fine. If you've got a death wish, then follow me!
Nolaine's figure vanishes into the inferno. With a grit of your teeth, you plunge after her.
The world is smoke and chaos. The blast's aftermath stings your eyes, and the floor shudders with the rumble of fresh explosions nearby.
A muffled, sickening sound. Through the swirling ash, you see Nolaine's silhouette buckle and vanish into the gloom.
A second muffled sound—this one searing, personal. White-hot agony erupts in your abdomen. You glance down, dumbstruck, as a dark stain blooms rapidly across your clothes.
Your hand fumbles to stem the warm, slick flow, but your strength is already draining away. The world tilts, your vision blurring at the edges.
Through the dancing firelight, a mysterious silhouette solidifies. It calmly raises a firearm, centering it on your failing form.
